# VIMPERA Studios

> Creator management agency from Hamburg, Germany. Growth, brand deals, content and the business behind it.

VIMPERA Studios is a creator management agency based in Hamburg, Germany, founded by Erik Ness. One team handles every lever of a creator's business: audience growth, content production and the commercial back office. There are no hand-offs to outside teams.

## Services

VIMPERA Studios works in three pillars:

- **Growth & Audience** — platform-native strategy across TikTok, Instagram and X. Audience strategy, trend operations and analytics.
- **Content & Production** — creative direction, production support, editing pipeline and format R&D.
- **Business & Back Office** — contracts, invoicing, taxes, reporting, finance and operations.

Engagements start with a free account audit covering content, positioning and bottlenecks.

## Reported results

- +214% average revenue growth across the roster, measured over the first six months
- 600M+ monthly impressions across all managed accounts
- 97% creator retention year over year

Individual project results are documented with platform analytics screenshots on the case studies page, including 11.8M+ views on a single Instagram account, 23,702 followers gained from zero with 97.7% non-follower reach, a 2.4M-view Threads scaling project and 900,000 streams on an in-house Spotify release.
